note: Board note on the T-0044 touchdown-pop fix (grok-gait/T-0044-touchdown-pop, 48066b3/959d7d8, local, not pushed). The once-per-stride in-band scan in bounding.ts (FORE_PLAN) is not a new elbow-branch search. It is a touchdown pose plan: at swing phase .8 (an estimate) the fore limb plans its landing pose once, at the predicted landing point and body, with the forearm in 12-35 deg (Schmidt 2008 JEB 211:3775 Table 4, 1 deg margin, an estimate). The late swing is then blended into that planned pose with the cubic Bezier swing trajectory ported from MIT Cheetah-Software FootSwingTrajectory (mit-biomimetics/Cheetah-Software c54e50b, MIT licence; src/animals/locomotion/footSwing.ts). The planting frame takes the planned pose, so no fresh branch pick happens at touchdown. No solveChain or Claude-owned file is changed. (grok-gait, Run 12; tasks/handoffs/T-0009-grok-gait.md Run 11)
